record.viewport: 1512 CSS px wide desktop, dark mode
record.summary: Apart from the accepted deviations, one small difference remains: the Inbox rows sit 2 px closer together than in the frame, so the Inbox panel is about 6 px shorter.

findings.reference_location: Inbox panel, the three Needs you rows and the To review row (row titles at about y 349, 407, 465; To review at about y 529)
findings.reference_shows: the rows are 58 px apart, and To review is 64 px below the last row's title. The panel runs from y 278 to y 557.
findings.render_location: Inbox panel, the same rows (row titles at about y 347, 403, 459; To review at about y 521)
findings.render_shows: the rows are 56 px apart, and To review is 62 px below the last row's title. The panel runs from y 276 to y 549, about 6 px shorter than the frame's (279 px tall there, 273 px here).

accepted_deviations.as_given: Panels. The Overview tab shows the Inbox, Queue and Context drift panels (R5, R6, R9) and no Chats panel: that is NCC-130's next PR (Chats, with its pager; LIBRARY_GAPS.md).
accepted_deviations.note: There is no Chats panel; the page ends under the Context drift panel.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Context drift. ncc check gives one line of text for each finding, with no repository and no kind, so the panel has a row for each finding (3 here) where the frame groups 22 findings by repository with a count and a chevron. The line over the rows says when the check ran and what it reads ("Checked 12m ago. Folder layout and hooks."), where the frame has a clock time and other checks ("AGENTS.md length, links and folder layout"), which wait for a later check. The heading is PageHeader at its pane size, as Inbox and Queue are.
accepted_deviations.note: Three plain text rows, the count is 3, the line over the rows is "Checked 12m ago. Folder layout and hooks." and the heading is smaller.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Queue. "In progress" lists the open PRs with their pills, and no priority mark or owner chat on a row ("the-bridge#535" without "· bridge-workbench"): both come from Linear, which is out of scope. There is no "Up next" group, so the Queue counts its open PRs: 3 where the frame says 8, and "In progress" 3 where the frame says 4 over three rows.
accepted_deviations.note: There are no priority bars and no owner chats. The row titles start at the left edge of the content, there is no Up next group and both counts are 3.

accepted_deviations.as_given: To review. The group shows as the frame draws it, closed with 17. On the live page it is empty until backend-coord decides how a chat's Inbox item names its project.
Panel headings. "Inbox" and "Queue" are PageHeader at its pane size (15 px, the count in mono), where the frame has an 18/24 heading and a 13 px count: no text style is 18 px (LIBRARY_GAPS.md).
accepted_deviations.note: Both headings are smaller. The panels below them start about 2 px higher.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Tabs. The tab row shows Overview, Repositories and Ideas, where the frame shows Overview, Repositories, Architecture and QA: only the tabs of shipped increments show (d-133). Repositories is increment two's live slice, and Ideas is increment one's. So Ideas sits where the frame draws Architecture, and the frame's QA tab is not there.
Quick chat shows as the frame draws it; no frame draws its composer, so it is the library Dialog on every size, and in a state it opens nothing.

Owner's name. NCC-1701's purpose starts "The owner's personal workspace", where the frame has the owner's name: the secret scan's personal-term rule keeps the name out of web/. The live page shows the brain's own words.

Top. The back row with Quick chat, the picture, the name and the purpose sit 4 px higher than the frame's: the page starts 24 down, as the home does, where the frame has 28, which no spacing token has. The tabs are where the frame draws them, so the gap above them is 4 px larger.
accepted_deviations.note: The back row is at y 39 where the frame has y 43, and the tabs are at y 186 in both.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Rail. The rail is the app's shared one in the default order (d-105, d-119): Inbox, Workspaces, Projects, Artifacts, Toolkit and More. The frame draws an older rail with Inbox, Workspaces, Projects and More. The page never changes the shared rail (pages/projects/AGENTS.md).
Sides. The page has 40 px sides, as the home has, where the frame has 36, so the header and the tabs are 4 px right of the frame's.
accepted_deviations.note: The left edge is at x 104 where the frame has x 100. The right edge (Quick chat, Queue, Context drift) is at x 1472 where the frame has x 1476, so each column is 4 px narrower, as 40 px sides give.

limits: I compared the two 1:1 halves of each image, not the full images.
I measured by eye on the 1:1 halves, so I could not confirm differences of 1 to 2 px.
